title: Workflow Automation DPA Subprocessors: 2026 Guide
summary: Workflow automation DPA subprocessors control data handling in integrations. Choose between enterprise support, DPA compliance, or self-hosted options.
body_markdown:
## Tool-by-tool Verdicts on DPA and Subprocessors


Only when its own trust page, signed-form DPA and subprocessor list have been read and dated does a platform count as confirmed on DPA and subprocessor terms. Anything short of that stays unconfirmed.


For Zapier, take the DPA and subprocessor list from its own legal and trust pages, with the retrieval date recorded. Unconfirmed here: whether the DPA is available on every plan or only on negotiated ones, and how the vendor delivers change notices for new subprocessors.


For Make, accept only its own legal documents as a source. Check the notice mechanism for subprocessor additions and whether the DPA writes in objection rights or a web page only describes them. Plan-level availability of the DPA is unconfirmed.


With n8n there are two answers, because it splits into its cloud service and a self-hosted option. For cloud, read the DPA and subprocessor list.


For self-hosted, the vendor processes little of your workflow data, so the subprocessors that matter are the ones you choose for hosting, with their own contracts. Whether a given licence tier changes this is unconfirmed.


### Workato, Power Automate and Activepieces


Because Workato sells mainly through negotiated contracts, the DPA you are shown may differ from the template on its public pages. Ask for the executed version and the current subprocessor list. Price and limits are quote-based, so no list price can be compared.


Rather than a standalone automation DPA, Power Automate's data-protection terms come through Microsoft's broader commercial agreements. The question is which document governs this product and where its subprocessor disclosures sit. Confirm that against Microsoft's own documentation, not a reseller's summary.


Activepieces' connector library holds 750 integrations, counted from its open source monorepo, and roughly 60% of them are community-contributed, so most integrations rely on volunteer maintenance.


That says nothing about data processing. Breadth of connectors is not a contract term.


For the DPA, the same checks apply as for every other vendor on the shortlist. Read its own legal pages, record the date, and confirm what the cloud service discloses.


Because the self-hosted option moves subprocessor risk to your own hosting choices, a cloud-side answer doesn't carry over.


The control side doesn't split the same way, though: the air-gapped self-hosted edition and the managed cloud, including its EU region in Frankfurt, carry the same enterprise controls, so moving the data path in-house doesn't mean buying a thinner product.


The self-hosted docs and the cloud plans list the same set, from SSO and SCIM through custom RBAC, audit logs, release management and secret managers. MoneyGram, Moneypenny, Alan and FundingSocieties run Activepieces in production.


What the current subprocessor list contains and which plans include a DPA remain unconfirmed here.
